results.title: Ponytail
results.overview: Laleh, a 35-year-old midwife, arrives at the home of Akhtar, a pregnant woman, to examine her. Against her own wishes, she removes the stillborn fetus and saves Akhtar’s life, only to discover that the house might be haunted by supernatural entities.

results.title: Giudecca
results.overview: Set inside a progressive women's prison on Venice's Giudecca island, an art workshop becomes a space for four inmates—Jenni, Rachida, Patrizia, and Giulia—to paint their self-portraits and share their pasts. Through stories of violence, guilt, survival, and broken bonds, the documentary explores how forced confinement ultimately sparks a profound process of self-reflection and personal awareness.

results.title: A Mare
results.overview: An ensemble narrative follows a group of African mothers and children living in Rome’s squatted buildings during a day trip to the beach. When a young boy named Adonai disappears, it brings to light the shared trauma of crossing the Mediterranean, confronting the mothers with their painful memories and connecting the community through a deeply spiritual relation with the sea.

results.title: Two from a Trio
results.overview: In a small city in Spain, an amateur poet crosses paths with a pickpocket who helps him in unexpected ways.

results.title: The Feels - Or The Debilitated Condition of the Reproductive System
results.original_title: The Feels - Or The Debilitated Condition of the Reproductive System
results.overview: In a near-future world where engineered emotions have replaced real experience, a corporation sells “feels” distilled from social media memories. When a partner deletes their online past, a memory technician finds their relationship suddenly incompatible, as if it never existed. But as demand outpaces supply, the company begins harvesting the memories of its own workers, forcing them to confront a world where the more you feel, the less it’s yours.

results.title: The Room of Others
results.overview: Mietta, a retired woman in her seventies living alone in Milan, opens her home to Ibu, a Senegalese friend, and his pregnant wife, Bousso. What was meant to be temporary accommodation becomes a long-term arrangement, as their son Khadim grows up alongside them. Over the years, tensions and differences challenge their domestic balance, but also create the possibility of building a family beyond blood ties.

results.title: Linear Endjoy
results.overview: The phosphor layer of a cathode ray tube visualizes the final vanishing of an electron beam – its last “happy” moment.  A Pale Blue Dot Matter Wave.  A minimalist short film exploring the traces of electronic imaging and perception. It operates between physical materiality, temporality, and subjective experience.

results.title: Chicks
results.overview: The everyday lives of young women after arrest — in a detention centre, and in the time before.

results.title: Before the Sun
results.overview: A summer camp on the Black Sea becomes a coming-of-age place for teenagers from an orphanage. Masha looks after her younger sister; Ksyusha lives with the fallout of a first love; Akim waits in the hope that his father will soon return.

results.title: Archives from Hell: The Making of Demo_N
results.original_title: Archives from Hell: The Making of Demo_N
results.overview: A retrospective documentary series on the innovative experience in screenlife horror - Demo_N.

results.title: Chéri on Top
results.overview: Rebecca recounts the disastrous afternoon she has just experienced. She had planned the perfect gender reveal party for her pregnant friend Daphne. But Lennart, the soon to be father, behaves like a child. His actions trigger a wild chain reaction that turns what was meant to be a joyful afternoon into a nightmare.

results.title: Tides
results.overview: Tides observes the daily rhythms of lobstermen and kelp harvesters on Swan’s Island, Maine, where time is measured by tides and weather. Without dialogue or narration, the film immerses viewers in the tactile, sensory world of maritime labor: setting and hauling lobster traps, sorting the catch, lifting kelp from the water. There are no protagonists here, not even among the workers themselves. Instead, the film offers an attentive, quietly reverent portrait of labor as a collective practice, marked by moments of care, precision and tenderness that emerge through repetition. By focusing on these elemental gestures, the work uncovers the quiet knowledge and endurance passed down through generations, offering a contemplative study of human interaction with the environment and the unspoken practices that sustain a community.

results.title: MicroMacro [Motorized vs Handheld]
results.overview: MicroMacro (Motorized vs Handheld) examines the fragile threshold between perception and scale, between the mechanical eye and the human hand. Filmed entirely by the artist in remote regions of northern Iceland, the work moves between two contrasting modes of seeing and experiencing: the expansive reach of aerial drone footage and the intimate, unstable proximity of microscopic imagery. Together, these perspectives trace a continuum from surveillance to touch, from estrangement and detachment to texture, vulnerability and participation.

results.title: Ignis et Glacies
results.overview: The Yukon River at Dawson City (Tr'ondëk Hwëch'in) on November 15, 2025. The ice has covered the river but not memories of summer fires. Filmed in 16mm, Developed with sunflower developer. Phytograms with mint, parsley, rosemary, thyme and spider plant. Made for the Yukon48 Film Challenge.

results.title: La Marea
results.overview: Tracing the waters of the Santa Barbara Channel and the passage surrounding the Channel Islands, guided by the belief of many coastal tribes that souls of the dead travel west over the ocean, La Marea explores the sea as a threshold between the living and the departed. Through tides, light and shifting currents, ancestral cosmologies intertwine with contemporary stories of exile and return. Created in dialogue with Bryan Senti’s musical composition, part of a larger body of work inspired by his father’s exile from Cuba by sea, La Marea carries these oceanic crossings into a shared reflection on displacement, remembrance and the invisible forces that continue to move through us.

results.title: Painting Cathedral Rock
results.overview: Painting Cathedral Rock is an experimental work in which painting, performance and film converge to explore landscape, ritual, colonialism and the fragile boundaries between spectacle, spirituality and perception.

results.title: Indigenous Joy
results.overview: A First Nations woman asks herself, "What is Indigenous Joy?" A short Super 8mm film, produced as part of the Winnipeg Film Groups’ Super 8 Special Film Incubator.
